questions.e: In the video: "otvoren je prvi alpaka kafe u Srbiji" — the first alpaca café in Serbia has opened.

o: Near Zrenjanin, inside the Trofej restaurant
questions.e: In the video: "U blizini Zrenjanina, u okviru restorana Trofej" — near Zrenjanin, inside the Trofej restaurant.

questions.q: How much does entry cost and what does it include?
questions.e: In the video: "plaćate kartu u iznosu od 1200 dinara, uz koju dobijete neograničeno piće" — you pay for a ticket of 1200 dinars, with which you get unlimited drinks.

questions.q: From which side should you approach the alpacas?
questions.e: In the video: "Alpakicama se prilazi isključivo sa prednje strane, kako bi vas videle" — alpacas are approached exclusively from the front so that they can see you.

questions.q: Can you take photos and shoot video?
o: Yes, as much as you like
questions.e: In the video: "slikanje i snimanje dozvoljeno, što se kaže, do mile volje" — photos and filming are allowed, as they say, to your heart's content.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Hranite ih kad u ruci imate *šargarepu*.

questions.e: U blizini ("near") requires the genitive case: Zrenjanina.

questions.q: Alpakicama se prilazi isključivo sa prednje ___.
questions.e: Sa prednje strane — "from the front side"; genitive case.

questions.q: otvoren je ___ alpaka kafe u Srbiji.
questions.e: The adjective agrees with the noun: kafe is masculine, so prvi.
